title: TuneX probe-telemetry-v1 independent cumulative execution observations
description: Closed operational counts, not Probe permits, result receipts, current health, packet loss or execution authority. Existing Probe execution contracts and ADP are unchanged. Duplicate JSON keys must be rejected by the normative raw parser. Raw samples are limited to 65536 UTF-8 bytes, ACKs to 4096 bytes and normalized points to 4096 bytes. Exact integer, calendar, equality, distinct-generation and cross-field rules described here are normative parser/application checks beyond structural validation.

Uint64Decimal.description: Canonical decimal uint64 in [0,18446744073709551615], no whitespace or leading zeroes. The normative telemetryUint64 parser additionally checks the exact numeric upper bound using integer arithmetic.

Time.description: Strict UTC at or after 1970-01-01, optional 1..9 fractional digits, through year 9999. Normative parser validates the actual Gregorian date and nonnegative epoch; leap seconds, offsets and whitespace are rejected. Compare fractional instants without millisecond truncation.

Binding.description: The existing eleven-field ProbeClaimBinding shape, copied structurally without changing its execution contract. A published binding is not proof of a current Probe instance, permission or every individual permit.

Counters.description: Attempted/succeeded/failed/unknown are cumulative; inFlight is a current gauge, never a monotonic counter. When overflowed=false, the normative point parser requires attempted=succeeded+failed+unknown+inFlight exactly. When overflowed=true, saturated values do not promise conservation. Completion deltas may exceed interval attempted when work was already in flight.

Point.description: Normative parser also requires terminal endedAt to equal capturedAt byte-for-byte, point capturedAt<=sample capturedAt using nanosecond comparison, exact outer nodeId/bootId/sessionEpoch equality and normalized point UTF-8 length<=4096. Unavailable is not zero. Current/terminal observations do not authorize execution or prove health.

Coverage.description: Normative arithmetic: returned=items.length<=min(32,available), omitted=available-returned, truncated=(omitted>0). Returning fewer than the point limit is permitted because at most two distinct binding.snapshotGeneration values are exported. Available<=384+retiringSources*256, bounded to 2432: at most 256 current, 128 frozen tails and eight retiring pure-numeric CounterSet readers with at most 256 bindings each. Retiring readers hold no Gate/Runner/context/credential/callback, expire within 600 seconds and are bounded/evicted; only after their registered calls finish can immutable terminal values enter the 128-value tail. unavailableSources counts failure of the one current GateRegistry source, may be 1 even when available=0, and is not a point count. When available>0 require offset<available; truncated nextOffset=(offset+max(1,returned)) mod available, otherwise nextOffset=0. All tail/source history is memory-only and incomplete; restart, expiry and eviction lose coverage.

Sample.description: Normative sample parser rejects duplicate complete identity+counterEpoch pairs, binds point machine identity to the outer sample, rejects future point timestamps, validates coverage against items.length and allows at most two distinct point binding.snapshotGeneration values. No outer snapshotGeneration field is defined. Raw body maximum is 65536 bytes.

Ack.description: Normative parser requires acceptedPoints+rejectedPoints<=32. Client must bind machine/export identity to its submitted sample and require accepted+rejected=sample.items.length. Raw ACK maximum4096bytes. stored=true means bounded observation intake only.
